objective:
Goal: the article's print and export options are shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "To do this, click the Print/export link on the left sidebar in Wikipedia when you're on an article you want to save.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: visible UI navigation toward the article's print and export options; role=button; text="Main menu" | HINTS: position=top-left; container=Wikipedia header
actions.instr: Clicking the Main menu to open print and export options

actions.intent: PRIMARY: visible UI navigation toward the article's print and export options; role=button; text="Tools" | HINTS: position=upper article toolbar; container=Page tools
actions.instr: Clicking Tools in the article toolbar

actions.intent: whether the article's print option is present (in the Page tools Print/export section)
actions.instr: Checking whether the article print option is shown

actions.intent: whether the article's export option is present (in the Page tools Print/export section)
actions.instr: Checking whether the article export option is shown
